about: The approved stack. tests/architecture/test_stack.py and ui/tests/stack.test.cjs fail when a manifest names a dependency that is not here, or this file names one no manifest uses. Adding, removing or swapping an entry needs Adam's go-ahead first (AGENTS.md, 'Stack and shared modules').

dependencies.react: The UI framework. Function components and hooks only.
dependencies.plotly.js-cartesian-dist-min: Charts. Figures are built by the server; draw them with LiveFigure or PlotlyChart.
dependencies.leaflet: Maps, behind ui/src/map/engine.ts (MapKit is the other engine).
dependencies.cytoscape: Graph views (entity graph, network), through ui/src/graph.tsx.
dependencies.bpmn-js: The workflow diagram viewer and modeler (BpmnView, BpmnModeler).
dependencies.@bpmn-io/form-js-viewer: Renders a task's form from its schema (TaskForm). The one way to draw a workflow form.
dependencies.mermaid: Diagrams in assistant answers, through MermaidDiagram.
dependencies.pdfjs-dist: Documents and drawings, through DocumentViewer and DrawingViewer.

devDependencies.tailwindcss: Theme tokens and base styles; components use the kit's classes, not utility strings in pages.

fuzer.fastapi: The HTTP API. Every data or execution router uses AuthenticatedRoute.
fuzer.psycopg: Postgres, the only database. No ORM: SQL through the existing stores.
fuzer.httpx: Outbound HTTP: PI Web API, ADX, Teams.
fuzer.anthropic: Claude. The only model SDK in the default install.
fuzer.agent-framework-core: The operations assistant and its specialists (Microsoft Agent Framework).
fuzer.dagster: Scheduled loads, rebuilds and agent runs. The only scheduler.
fuzer.dagster-postgres: Dagster's storage in the app's Postgres.
fuzer.deltalake: Delta Lake tables in the lake connector.
fuzer.scipy: Statistics and signal methods in analyses.
fuzer.matplotlib: Chart images the assistant looks at. Charts for people are Plotly figures.

fuzer[openai].agent-framework-openai: Optional: the assistant on an OpenAI-compatible model.
fuzer[openai].openai: Optional: the OpenAI SDK for that provider.

dev.pytest: Tests, in unit, integration and e2e tiers.
dev.spiffworkflow: Reference behaviour the work engine is tested against. Tests only.
dev.thermo: Equations of state for checking fake-plant design points. Tests only.

fakeplant.fuzer: The fake plants build on Fuzer (workspace package).
fakeplant.pillow: Draws the fake drawings and photos.
